name: agent-vm-guest-pi-packages
description: Pinned Pi extension packages for the agent-vm guest image. images/tools/pi/Dockerfile installs this with `npm ci --ignore-scripts --omit=optional --legacy-peer-deps` into /opt/agent-vm/pi-packages, and the wrapper loads pi-claude-bridge from it with a second --extension. See images/tools/README.md for the bump recipe and why both npm flags are mandatory.
